Welcome to the United States of America 🇺🇸 Just 1 week until America’s 250th Birthday! 🎉 ✨ From spectacular fireworks and patriotic celebrations to parades, concerts, festivals and special events across the country, it’s one of the most exciting times to visit the USA ❤️🤍💙 Now step into New York City 🗽 ✨ The city that never sleeps, where iconic landmarks, incredible architecture and unforgettable energy come together around every corner 📍10 Must-Visit Locations in NYC 1️⃣ Statue of Liberty 🗽 The ultimate symbol of freedom and one of America’s most famous landmarks 2️⃣ Central Park 🌳 Escape the city’s hustle with beautiful paths, lakes, and iconic views 3️⃣ Times Square ✨ Bright lights, giant billboards and nonstop energy day and night 4️⃣ Brooklyn Bridge 🌉 Walk across for breathtaking skyline views and unforgettable photos 5️⃣ Empire State Building 🏙️ Experience one of the best panoramic views of New York City from its observation decks 6️⃣ Grand Central Terminal 🏛️ A historic masterpiece with one of the world's most beautiful train halls 7️⃣ The High Line 🌿 An elevated park filled with gardens, art and amazing city views 8️⃣ Rockefeller Center 🏢 Home to a famous observation deck and iconic NYC atmosphere 9️⃣ DUMBO 📸 A charming Brooklyn neighborhood with stunning waterfront and bridge views 🔟 Fifth Avenue 🛍️ The perfect place for iconic architecture, shopping, and classic New York vibes Save this list for your future NYC adventure and share it with someone who dreams of visiting New York City! 🗽✈️🇺🇸 ••• Follow @alexanewyorkcity for more travel inspiration •••#newyorkcity #usa #newyork #newyorknewyork #nyc
